sources.title: 'It will be a paradigm shift': Daphne Koller on machine learning in drug discovery
sources.quote_checked: machine learning will be an absolutely critical, pivotal shift | Every successful drug has to bear on its back the cost of all the failures. | We aspire to create a much more engineered process, with a higher success rate. | if we let machines have an unfettered, unanchored look at the data | That's very rarely the case | Our bigger advantage is that we generate, in-house, complementary forms of data | Biology is really hard, and we need to be very careful when intervening in something as precious as human life.

sources.title: Famed founder Daphne Koller tells it straight: 'With most drugs, we do not understand why they work'
sources.quote_checked: most drugs fail because they are targeting the wrong things. | They are targeting proteins or genes that do not affect the disease they are supposed to affect. | we're in the business of actually building data for the sole purpose of training machine learning models.

sources.title: Koller turns AI on drug discovery with newco insitro
SF Healthcare Week: insitro CEO Daphne Koller on how AI is hitting escape velocity for finding causal targets for disease and speeding up drug development
